metadata.description: Claude Code plugins maintained by Contract Hero — Sui Move tooling and developer-experience extensions.

plugins.name: sui-pilot
plugins.description: Sui Move development plugin — 812 bundled docs, Move LSP integration, Sui Prover formal verification, and five specialized skills (code quality, security review, math safety, formal specs, verification).

plugins.name: code-forge
plugins.description: Multi-agent build system with TDD-as-phase, script-coordinated parallel review, best-of-N implementer, and forge-guard hook discipline.

plugins.name: agentic-community-college
plugins.description: Claude Code learning framework (v0.3 chapter model). A course plugin splits a lesson into chapters defined by tests; the conductor implements each chapter in a seeded workspace, explains it with a self-contained HTML artifact, and closes the lesson with an end-to-end test and a summary page. Ships the MCP server plus the course-engine, course-conductor, course-creator, lesson-creator and chapter-artifact skills. Pair with a course plugin such as acc-claude-sdk.

plugins.name: acc-claude-sdk
plugins.description: ACC course: build agents with the Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript), chapter by chapter, with tests as the contract. Lesson 1 runs a query() and reads the result message, adds a custom in-process tool via createSdkMcpServer(), and wraps it in a testable CLI; the live end-to-end test needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. First course on the ACC v0.3 chapter model. Requires the agentic-community-college plugin to run.

plugins.name: acc-deepbook-course
plugins.description: DeepBook content for the Agentic Community College (ACC) framework — bundles hands-on lessons that walk learners through building Sui DeepBook integrations end-to-end. Requires the agentic-community-college plugin to run. Built on the ACC v0.2 section model (previous work): pending migration to v0.3 chapters, so it does not run on the current agentic-community-college release.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Self-contained HTML deliverable toolkit — bundles html-artifact (one-off visual deliverables), publish-html (turn a local .html into a shareable URL), for-dummies (auto-derived project intros), and move-call-chains (HTML call-chain diagrams for Sui Move packages). When enabled, agentic-community-college offers publish-html on the lesson summary artifact.

plugins.name: acc-evm-wal
plugins.description: ACC content plugin teaching Walrus decentralized storage from Solidity and TypeScript: six Foundry and pnpm lessons (blob anchoring, Walrus Sites, an ENS-gated resolver, DAO proposals, a verifiable manifest client, a quilt-backed ERC-721), each gated on its test suite. Requires the agentic-community-college plugin to run. Built on the ACC v0.2 section model (previous work): pending migration to v0.3 chapters, so it does not run on the current agentic-community-college release.

plugins.name: sui-agent-tank
plugins.description: Guided evaluation harness — grade a Sui-stack context bundle (a skill folder or a Claude Code plugin) by GitHub URL. /tank clones it, auto-detects the kind, runs a containerized agent through compile/test gates + Move anti-pattern traps + a cross-model judge, and reports.

plugins.name: vlerv
plugins.description: Send local files straight to your paired Vlervtifacts devices over a direct, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer link, and write vlerv:// links that open on any of them rather than only on the Mac that made them.

plugins.name: skypie
plugins.description: Send local files straight to your paired Sky Pie devices over a direct, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer link, and write skypie:// links that open on any of them rather than only on the Mac that made them.
